help_topics.description: Requires view-help advertised in hello and requested in registration, including an empty authored array. Distinct topic IDs; at most 64 KiB of titles and paragraphs in total. Views select one with model or header help.

helpTopic.description: Workflow prose for contextual help. Titles are at most 64 UTF-8 bytes and paragraphs at most 2048; neither accepts controls. Action labels and keys are generated by the host, not authored here.

help.description: Requires negotiated view-help. Names a registered help topic, which Space ? opens for this view.
